main.description: Looks up one contribution record by exact AT-URI; authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full AT-URI of the contribution record, using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI must identify a contribution record with a DID authority.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed contribution record exists at this AT-URI.

errors.name: ContributionQueryFailed
errors.description: The contribution record or publisher could not be read from PostgreSQL.

contributionView.description: Contribution record view with a hydrated publisher and unchanged source record; the publisher is not necessarily the contributor.
